# DSH Account Balance Badge

A persistent DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
plugin that keeps the signed-in DeepSeek account balance

visible in the **left sidebar**, with a
one-click in-app recharge action that opens DeepSeek's offic
ial top-up page without leaving the app.
中文说明
## Features

- **Always visible, on the left**: a full-width balance row in the sidebar footer, directly above
Se

ttings (below the shipped Cordis plugins row), so it stays visible across home, settings, and
conver

sation views instead of hiding inside the Account settings page.
- **Recharge and bonus wallets**: s

hows every wallet returned by the account service with the
Platform's currency formatting (CNY `¥`,

USD `$`; two decimals with digit grouping; sub-cent
amounts shown as `<¥0.01`). Positive bonus credi

t is appended as a small `Bonus ¥x.xx` note.
- **Recharge inside the app**: a compact `Top up` (充值)

button beside the amount opens the official
DeepSeek top-up page as an in-app native Platform view o

n the Desktop app, with a
"Back to DeepSeek Harness" bar; returning re-reads the balance. A plain We

b UI opens the same page
in a new tab instead. The button is disabled while signed out.
- **Sensible

refresh**: reads once on mount, refreshes every 60 seconds while the page is visible,
on window foc

us, when the row is clicked, and after returning from the top-up page. Reads are
in-flight deduplica

ted.
- **Localized and theme-aware**: English and Chinese copy follows the interface language; color

s
use the host theme tokens, so light and dark themes and the collapsed 36 px rail both work.
- **Cr

edentials never reach the browser**: the balance is read through the Host account service via
the Cl

ient Remote `account.getBalance` method, and the top-up page is a Desktop-owned native view
authenti
cated by the Desktop's own Platform session — no raw account tokens are exposed to the page.
## Requirements

- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` (verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile-managed DSH installation (th

e Desktop app, or `dsh web` launched with a profile), with
the shipped Web UI plugins enabled (the s

idebar, locale, and account controller are part of the
standard Web app).
- A signed-in DeepSeek acc

ount for amounts; a signed-out installation shows the localized
"signed out" state instead of an amo

unt and keeps the recharge action disabled.
- In-app recharge needs the **Desktop app**: it uses the

preload-owned `dshPlatform` bridge to host
the official page in a native view. A plain browser buil

d opens the deployment's top-up URL in a
new tab instead.
## Install

The plugin is distributed from GitHub —
repository ·
latest release.
It is not on npm yet, so instal

l it from the Git address or from the release tarball.
A step-by-step macOS walkthrough (both langua

ges) lives in
docs/INSTALL-macOS.en.md and docs/INSTALL-macOS.md.
### From the DSH Web UI (recommended)

1. In DSH, select **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** (or the arrow → **Install

a third-party plugin**).
3. Enter one of:
- a Git address: `github:NebulaXIX/dsh-account-balance-ba

dge` (tracks `main`), or
`github:NebulaXIX/dsh-account-balance-badge#v0.2.0` to pin the release
- th

e release tarball: the absolute path to `dsh-account-balance-badge-0.2.0.tgz`
- an absolute path to

a local checkout
4. Click **Install**.
5. When installation finishes, choose **Enable now**. A profi

le with HMR recomposes immediately;
otherwise restart DeepSeek Harness. The balance row appears in t
he left sidebar footer.

The Desktop app manages the `desktop` profile itself, so the Plugins UI is the only supported
instal

p manages the `desktop` profile itself, so the Plugins UI is the only supported
install route there.
### With the `dsh` CLI
Requires the `dsh` CLI and `pnpm` on your `PATH`; start DSH once first so the target profile exists.
`--profile` is required, and `desktop` is reserved for the Desktop app:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This package is plain JavaScript with no dependencies and no build script, so a Git install needs no

pnpm build-script approval. `dsh plugin ... add` also appends the bundle to the profile's bundle
li
st, so no manual patch editing is needed.

> **Not on npm yet.** `dsh plugin ... add dsh-account-balance-badge` (the package name) only works
>
after an npm release; until then use the Git address or the release tarball above.
### Update / uninstall

Third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling the new version — in the Web UI
fr
om the bundle page (**Uninstall**, then install again), or with the CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Usage

- The row shows a wallet icon, the localized label, and the current balance(s).
- Click the row to r

efresh; it also refreshes when the window regains focus and every 60 seconds
while the page is visib

le.
- Click **Top up** (充值) beside the amount to recharge: on the Desktop app the official DeepSeek

top-up page opens inside the application window under a "Back to DeepSeek Harness" bar, and
returnin

g re-reads the balance; in a plain Web UI the same page opens in a new tab.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
| Half | File | Role |
| Host | `index.js` | Empty bundle half: carries the Loader row only, adds no Host capability, tool,

or prompt surface. |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the row in `sidebar.footer.action` and one
page host in `shell.overlay`; reads balances through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`; asks the Deskt
op preload bridge (`globalThis.dshPlatform`) to host the top-up page and renders the row, the return

bar, and the component-local stylesheet. |
| Loader patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `accou

nt-balance-badge` row named after this package. |
| Display metadata | `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.
json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, and icon. |

The balance read is a Host-to-Platform query performed by the account service; the browser only
rece

ives wallet amounts (currency and decimal strings). The recharge page is not rendered by this
plugin

at all: the Desktop owns the native `WebContentsView` and its Platform credentials, while the
plugi

n only contributes the 48 px return bar and reports the measured viewport rectangle
(`open` / `setBo
unds` / `close` on the preload bridge).
